title: Build a clear paragraph · study notes
source: Original writing exercise; a useful scaffold, not a universal writing rule.
copy:
Exact title: "Build a clear paragraph". Exact subtitle: "One idea, developed with care.". Body copy (verbatim):
Point: state the main idea.
Support: add an example or evidence.
Explain: show why the support matters.
Link: connect to the next idea.
Small sticky note copy: "This is a useful scaffold, not a rule for every paragraph.".
Diagram: Four offset pastel index cards stacked down the page and connected by pen arrows: Point, Support, Explain, Link. Next to them a tiny book, speech bubble, lightbulb and bridge. Plenty of generous writing space and an editorial notebook hierarchy.
invocation: Use $cad-illustrated-study-notes to explain build a clear paragraph for a beginner. Include an accurate diagram and one short tip. Use Ivory ruled paper, rose and amber accents, expressive brush heading, tidy handwritten body.
